title: Annotated U-2 photo: Soviet MRBM site in Cuba, 1 October 1962
description: Aerial reconnaissance photograph with interpretation labels "TENT AREA," "VEHICLES," "7 MISSILE TRAILERS," "ERECTORS" and "MISSILE TRAILER" with leader lines pointing to features. Captioned "Soviet MRBM site in Cuba, 1 October 1962." Chapter 5 text (page 210) mentions Kennedy's use of NPIC photographs on 22 October 1962 and the loss of Maj. Rudolph Anderson's U-2 on 27 October.
